The official English delivery independently states 2 September 1893 (https://www.vatican.va/content/leo-xiii/en/encyclicals/documents/hf_l-xiii_enc_02091893_constanti-hungarorum.html). The retained ASS OCR at original historical.txt LF5395 instead literally reads die 1 1 S e p t e m b r i s An. 1893; that source wording is preserved unchanged as a discrepant OCR witness. This is a metadata reconciliation against the official deliveries, not a claim that the original ASS printing was image-collated. The stable work ID and historical directory path remain unchanged.
